response_text: You shouldn’t call osYield from within context switching handlers like PendSV_Handler, SVC_Handler, or SysTick_Handler. These handlers are already a special type of interrupt responsible for managing task switches. Since osYield works by issuing an SVC instruction, which in turn triggers a PendSV interrupt to do the actual context switch, calling osYield from inside one of these handlers would be problematic. It would mean trying to initiate a new context switch while another is still ongoing, potentially causing nested exceptions that could lead to unpredictable behavior, system corruption, or stack issues. Eventually, this could cause the processor to enter a fault state.\n
